name: allocations
description: Resource allocation spread over working days: one row per allocation per day the person works, carrying the hours that fall on that day. NetSuite records an allocation as hours across a date range; the hours are spread evenly over the working days of the person's own work calendar in that range (weekdays, less that calendar's holidays; Monday to Friday for anyone without a calendar). Hard allocation is a confirmed commitment, soft is tentative.
